changeSet.author: inkomoko
changeSet.comment: Create audit table for partial write-off transactions (idempotent)
changeSet.sql: SET @table_exists = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_name = 'm_partial_writeoff_audit'); SET @sql = IF(@table_exists = 0, 'CREATE TABLE m_partial_writeoff_audit ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL, loan_id BIGINT NOT NULL, loan_transaction_id BIGINT NOT NULL, transaction_date date NOT NULL, principal_portion DECIMAL(19, 6) NULL, interest_portion DECIMAL(19, 6) NULL, fee_charges_portion DECIMAL(19, 6) NULL, penalty_charges_portion DECIMAL(19, 6) NULL, total_amount DECIMAL(19, 6) NOT NULL, loan_balance_before DECIMAL(19, 6) NOT NULL, loan_balance_after DECIMAL(19, 6) NOT NULL, reason VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, initiated_by BIGINT NOT NULL, initiated_on timestamp NOT NULL, approved_by BIGINT NULL, approved_on timestamp NULL, office_id BIGINT NOT NULL, note VARCHAR(1000) NULL, external_id VARCHAR(100) NULL, created_on_utc timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, last_modified_on_utc timestamp NULL, created_by BIGINT NULL, last_modified_by BIGINT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_M_PARTIAL_WRITEOFF_AUDIT PRIMARY KEY (id) )', 'SELECT "Table m_partial_writeoff_audit already exists"'); PREPARE stmt FROM @sql; EXECUTE stmt; DEALLOCATE PREPARE stmt;
